# Android Central

> Comprehensive Android ecosystem coverage including smartphone reviews, wearables, accessories, and processor technology across major manufacturers.

Android Central is the leading destination for Android phone and device news, reviews, and comparisons. The site covers flagship and budget devices from Samsung, Google Pixel, OnePlus, Motorola, and other manufacturers, alongside wearables like smartwatches and fitness trackers, plus in-depth processor and accessory guides.

## Key Topics

- Android phones
- Samsung Galaxy
- Google Pixel
- OnePlus
- Foldable phones
- Smartwatches
- Wear OS
- Qualcomm Snapdragon
- Phone reviews
- Wearable technology
- OLED displays
- Battery life
- Phone comparisons
- Android devices
- Budget phones

## Flagship Android Phones

- [Google Pixel Coverage](https://www.androidcentral.com/phones/google-pixel): Latest Google Pixel news, reviews and features including Pixel 10 Pro XL coverage
- [Samsung Galaxy Coverage](https://www.androidcentral.com/phones/samsung-galaxy): Samsung Galaxy news and reviews covering Galaxy S26, One UI updates and foldables
- [OnePlus](https://www.androidcentral.com/phones/oneplus): OnePlus phone reviews and leaks covering OnePlus 15, 15T and device comparisons

## Android Phones Hub

- [Phones](https://www.androidcentral.com/phones): Central hub for Android phone news, reviews and comparisons across Samsung, Pixel, OnePlus, Motorola
- [Unlocked Phones](https://www.androidcentral.com/unlocked-phones): Guide to unlocked Android phones including Pixel, OnePlus with carrier freedom options
- [Motorola](https://www.androidcentral.com/phones/motorola): Motorola phone coverage including Razr Fold and budget device comparisons

## Alternative Android Manufacturers

- [Nothing Phones Coverage](https://www.androidcentral.com/phones/nothing-phones): Nothing Phone 4a and 4a Pro reviews with Glyph design and OS update coverage
- [Xiaomi](https://www.androidcentral.com/phones/xiaomi): Xiaomi and POCO phone reviews including Xiaomi 17 Ultra and budget options
- [Oppo Coverage](https://www.androidcentral.com/phones/oppo-phones): OPPO phone news covering Find N6 foldable and flagship camera comparisons
- [Honor Phones Coverage](https://www.androidcentral.com/phones/honor-phones): Honor phone reviews including Magic 8 Pro Air and foldable device coverage

## Wearables & Smartwatches

- [Wearables](https://www.androidcentral.com/wearables): Android wearables hub covering smartwatches, fitness trackers and earbuds reviews
- [Google Pixel Watch Coverage](https://www.androidcentral.com/wearables/google-pixel-watch): Google Pixel Watch news and reviews covering Pixel Watch 3, 4 and Wear OS updates
- [Samsung Galaxy Watch](https://www.androidcentral.com/wearables/samsung-galaxy-watch): Samsung Galaxy Watch reviews including Galaxy Watch 8 and Ultra models
- [Garmin](https://www.androidcentral.com/wearables/garmin): Garmin smartwatch and fitness tracker coverage with GPS and battery life focus
- [COROS Coverage](https://www.androidcentral.com/wearables/coros): COROS running watch reviews including NOMAD and PACE Pro with GPS accuracy

## Accessories & Protection

- [Accessories](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories): Android accessories hub covering headphones, earbuds, power banks and smart home
- [Cases & Screen Protectors Coverage](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/cases-screen-protectors): Phone protection guides for Samsung Galaxy S26, Pixel 10a and foldable devices

## Mobile Processors & Technology

- [Qualcomm](https://www.androidcentral.com/phones/qualcomm): Qualcomm Snapdragon processor coverage including 5G, 6G and AI chip announcements
- [MediaTek Coverage](https://www.androidcentral.com/phones/mediatek): MediaTek processor news covering Dimensity series and smartphone SoC technology
